objective: Audit the September 9 followup: simultaneous mechanical-factor capacity, defect variation and monotone growth, ordinary-source exclusion of the specific square-root formal model, and the minimum odd count for negative same-Q carry.

quantifiers: finite complete odd prefixes from an odd positive source with initial defect zero, nonnegative defects and distinct full input states
infinite positive permanent-safe sources for the written asymptotic corollaries
odd sources 1 through 4095, at most 300 complete odd steps, stopping before coefficient failure or repetition
all safe negative-carry pairs with q<=21 through an exact extremal bound and a complete 48-case remainder; a literal q=22 witness
eight repeat-and-split certificates for the fixed square-root model at source bounds 2^B, B=8,16,32,64,128,256,512,1024
exact_scope.completeness: The finite orbit sample is not universal evidence. The q<=21 search is complete only through the written pruning proof. Repeat certificates exclude the specified finite prefixes and source bounds; the separate asymptotic proof excludes all positive ordinary sources for this particular model, not all safe words.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: none; integer powers, exact rationals, bit lengths, integer square roots and symbolic asymptotics

tests: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_phase13_properties.py tests/test_phase16_properties.py tests/test_phase21_properties.py tests/test_phase23_properties.py tests/test_phase37_properties.py tests/test_phase41_properties.py tests/test_phase41_verifier.py

verifier_reconstructs: full shortcut trajectories instead of the accelerated generator; mechanical alignment, strict state heights and parity separation
position-sum extremal corrections and forced-source forward decoding of the complete q=21 remainder
closed square-index defect formula instead of the model recurrence; literal repeats, later mismatch and exact affine source bounds

stop_conditions: Repair any missing distinctness, parity orientation or quantifier before accepting a theorem.
Do not extend depth merely to improve a finite record.
Preserve old accepted artifacts, especially Phase 41's historical unverified ordinary-source field.
interpretation_boundary: The specific square-root model is distinguished from the whole permanent-safe language.
The monotone lower bound does not assert monotonicity for actual geodesics.
General downward variation may compensate for small maximum defect.
No new external theorem or literature-wide novelty claim is used.
